1. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm __that has been trained on historical database performance data including actual execution metrics not available to the database optimizer__; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output __wherein the database operation predictor comprises a predicted performance metric that differs from cost estimates generated by the database optimizer__; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct __wherein the modification is performed by a component separate from the database optimizer__; and processing a database operation with the database constructs and the modified database construct.
